title: "05_analysis_1"
format: html

Library
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("ggplot2")
library("gridExtra")
library("grid")
library("purrr")
library("patchwork")
```

Load the clean and augmented data
```{r}
clean_data <- read_tsv(file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Look into 'death' variable
```{r}
death_table <- clean_data |> 
  count(death) 

clean_data |>
  summarise(,
    n_deaths = sum(death == 1),
    percent_deaths = round(
      100 * mean(death == 1),
      1
    )
  )

death_table <- tableGrob(death_table)

ggsave(
  "../results/05_analysis_1/death_variable_table.png",
  death_table,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Find binary variables and turn them into categorical
```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data |> 
  mutate(
    diabetes = factor(
      diabetes,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no", "yes")
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    chf = factor(
      chf,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("no", "yes")
    )
  ) 
```

Categorical values
```{r}
categorical_cols <- clean_data |> 
  select(where(is.character) | where(is.factor)) |> 
  names()

plots <- categorical_cols |> 
  map(function(col) {
    clean_data |> 
      group_by(.data[[col]]) |> 
      summarise(
        n = n(),
        percent_death = 100 * mean(death == 1),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |> 
      ggplot(aes(x = .data[[col]], y = percent_death)) +
      geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.6) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = paste0(round(percent_death, 1), "%")),
        vjust = -0.4,
        size = 3
      ) +
      labs(
        title = col,
        x = NULL,
        y = "Death rate (%)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
  })

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Death rate by categorical variables",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  )

combined_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/05_analysis_1/death_by_categorical_variables.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```

CH2 test
```{r}
table(clean_data$chf, clean_data$death) |>
  chisq.test()
table(clean_data$smoker, clean_data$death) |>
  chisq.test()
table(clean_data$race, clean_data$death) |>
  chisq.test()
table(clean_data$sex, clean_data$death) |>
  chisq.test()
table(clean_data$diabetes, clean_data$death) |>
  chisq.test()
```

Numeric values
```{r}
numeric_cols <- clean_data |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  names()

plots <- numeric_cols |> 
  map(function(col) {
    clean_data |> 
      ggplot(
        aes(
          x = factor(death, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No death", "Death")),
          y = .data[[col]],
          fill = factor(death, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No death", "Death"))
        )
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(
        outlier.shape = 21,
        outlier.size = 1.5,
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("No death" = "steelblue", "Death" = "tomato")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = col,
        x = NULL,
        y = col
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none"
      )
  })

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Numeric variables by death status",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  )

combined_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/05_analysis_1/numeric_variables_by_death.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```
